Option A — Baseline (24 GPUs):

Option B — Scaled (48 GPUs):
- Baseline throughput ~700M tokens/day; burst headroom to 1.2B tokens/day.
- 24-month reserved commit with 22% discount tier; includes an SLA addendum for p95 latency (region us-west).

Option C — Phased 36-month (anchor plan):
- 12-month soft-start at 50% baseline (12 GPUs), then step to 24 GPUs in month 13, and 48 GPUs in month 25.
- 36-month committed term with a 30% aggregate discount and an escalation cap for per-token overage.
- Guaranteed throughput windows negotiated per customer; billing can be aligned to fiscal quarters.

A few notes on guarantees and start dates: we can provide p95 latency guarantees tied to the model family and sequence length distribution — those require a short validation window on your representative traffic (we should run a 7–10 day pilot on a dedicated slot).
